note: Forward-test mandate (app/portfolio/guard.py). Only the user changes this, by a commit. Paper money only.
drawdown_note: Chosen 2026-09-27 (the user delegated the choice): the frozen book's worst backtest drop was 27% with brakes and 34% without, so 35% leaves room for an ordinary bad year while ruling out the 45-50% drops of the 60% setting and capping any later leverage at the 25-30% volatility row.
